headline: GOLD HEADS FOR BEST WEEK SINCE JANUARY — $4,254 Spot, Seven-Week High; All Eyes On NFP Print At 8:30 AM ET
snippet: Spot gold is trading at $4,254 per ounce on August 7, 2026 — a seven-week high and on track for its strongest weekly close since January — driven by the combined tailwinds of falling oil prices, a weaker dollar, and back-to-back soft US labour market prints (ADP 44K miss, ISM employment contraction) that have reset market expectations for the September FOMC meeting. CNBC notes the week's gains have reinforced technical support around the $4,000 floor established through the summer's volatility and have shifted the near-term narrative from 'correcting bull' back to 'renewed uptrend.' For retail mining investors, this is the macro environment that translates most directly into share price: gold miners' operating margins expand non-linearly above $4,200 because most AISC curves were modelled at $2,500–$3,200 — meaning free cash flow generation at current spot prices is running at multiples of budgeted figures for producers and dramatically re-rates the in-ground value of developers' resources.

headline: SILVER SURGES TO $64.35 — Sixth Consecutive Supply Deficit Now LARGEST ON RECORD At 215 Moz; $26 Gain In 12 Months
snippet: Silver is trading at $64.35 per ounce as of 5:15 AM Eastern on August 7, 2026 — a $2.52 gain in 24 hours and more than $26 higher than 12 months ago. The Silver Institute projects a 46.3-million-ounce supply deficit for 2026 — the sixth consecutive year of undersupply and the largest shortfall on record — bringing the cumulative six-year deficit to approximately 762 million ounces (23,705 metric tonnes). Industrial fabrication is absorbing 57% of total silver demand, driven by solar, EV, AI computing infrastructure, and semiconductors, with no comparable new primary silver mine supply capable of closing the gap before the end of the decade. For mining investors, six years of structural deficit at an accelerating pace means any primary silver producer, silver-rich polymetallic developer, or high-grade silver explorer is operating in a commodity environment where the supply argument gets stronger every year — not weaker.

headline: LUCA MINING DRILLS 184m AT 1.2 g/t Au + 72 g/t Ag AT LARGO NORTE — Near-Surface Polymetallic Extends Campo Morado Mine Life; 80,000m Campaign Active (TSX-V: LUCA)
snippet: Luca Mining Corp. (TSX-V: LUCA) reported August 7, 2026 that hole CMUG-26-50 at the Largo Norte zone of its Campo Morado polymetallic mine in Guerrero State, Mexico returned 184 metres of 1.18 g/t gold, 72.42 g/t silver, 0.39% copper, 0.45% lead, and 1.67% zinc from 3.6 metres downhole — including an 18-metre high-grade core at 2.64 g/t Au, 152.34 g/t Ag, 0.53% Cu, 1.05% Pb, and 2.52% Zn from 12 metres. The Largo Norte zone is unmined and lies adjacent to the existing Campo Morado operation; this result hints at meaningful resource growth potential capable of extending mine life at an operation already benefiting from elevated gold ($4,250+), silver ($64+), and copper ($6.65+) prices simultaneously. Luca is spending C$34 million on a combined 80,000-metre drill programme at Campo Morado and its Tahuehueto mine — one of the most ambitious junior drill programmes in Mexico this cycle. At current metals prices, the AuEq value of this intersection is exceptional for a near-surface intercept.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS DRILLS 28.0m AT 14.27 g/t AU AT UPPER ANTINO — Down-Dip Extension Confirms System Depth; 70,000m Programme Suriname (TSX-V: FDMIF)
snippet: Founders Metals Inc. (TSX-V: FDMIF) reported August 6, 2026 that hole FR249 at the Upper Antino target of its Antino Gold Project in southeastern Suriname returned 28.0 metres of 14.27 grams per tonne gold from 433 metres depth — a 50-metre down-dip extension of previously reported hole FR175. The result confirms that high-grade gold mineralization persists at depth in one of the most consistently high-grade drill programmes in South America this cycle, with the current 70,000-metre programme still actively defining the system's limits. Founders has previously intersected 53.1 metres of 1.21 g/t Au from surface in a new zone west of Upper Antino, discovered a new 1.2-kilometre gold system at Antino North, and confirmed new mineralization at Antino Northeast — suggesting the district-scale footprint of the Antino system is still expanding. An intercept of 28 metres at 14.27 g/t from 433 metres is a high-confidence indicator of a robust, structurally-controlled gold system: it is not a surface weathering effect and implies a coherent mineralized column that a future underground mine could follow.

headline: PERPETUA STIBNITE: FIRST DRILL IN A DECADE HITS GOLD, ANTIMONY AND TUNGSTEN — 21.3m @ 3.2 g/t Au + 0.9% W; 6.4m @ 16.2 g/t Au + 1.7% Sb; Idaho's Only Domestic Sb Reserve Gets Third Critical Mineral (NASDAQ: PPTA)
snippet: Perpetua Resources Corp. (NASDAQ: PPTA) reported August 6, 2026 results from its first exploratory drill programme at the Stibnite Gold Project in Valley County, Idaho in nearly a decade — returning new high-grade gold and antimony discoveries alongside a previously unidentified gold-tungsten zone. Highlights include 21.3 metres at 3.2 g/t gold and 0.9% tungsten at Yellow-Pine, 6.4 metres at 16.2 g/t gold and 1.7% antimony at Yellow-Pine, 3.0 metres at 14.5 g/t gold at Hangar Flats, and separate antimony-tungsten holes returning up to 22.9 metres at 3.2% antimony and 1.2% tungsten. Stibnite already holds the only identified domestic US reserve of antimony, which China has effectively weaponized through export controls since late 2024. The new tungsten zone — a metal where China controls approximately 80% of global supply and also under export controls — makes Stibnite a potential triple critical mineral project (gold, antimony, tungsten) at a single Idaho deposit. A minimum 10,000-metre 2026 core programme is underway with ~5,800 metres already drilled across four rigs.

headline: NORTHISLE NORTH ISLAND MRE SURGES 60% TO 10.1B LBS Cu-Eq — 330M New Tonnes; Red Dog, Hushamu, West Goodspeed Integrated; Pre-Feasibility Q1 2027 (TSX-V: NCX)
snippet: NorthIsle Copper and Gold Inc. (TSX-V: NCX) published August 5, 2026 an integrated mineral resource estimate for the North Island Project in British Columbia incorporating the Northwest Expo, Red Dog, West Goodspeed, and Hushamu deposits — totalling 10.1 billion pounds of copper equivalent in Indicated Resources, a 60% increase in contained Cu-Eq metal from the prior estimate. The update added 330 million tonnes to the Indicated category, contributing 685 million additional pounds of copper and 1.8 million additional ounces of gold, while molybdenum and rhenium credits increased 46% and 43% respectively (rhenium is itself a critical mineral used in high-temperature jet engine alloys). The integrated MRE will form the basis of a pre-feasibility study on track for completion in Q1 2027. At COMEX copper near $6.66 per pound, every additional billion pounds of in-ground copper equivalent at a BC porphyry project represents substantially more NAV than it did at $3.50 copper, and a 60% increase in contained metal is a major re-rating event for any junior copper developer.

headline: TOCVAN DRILLS 215m AT 0.6 g/t AU ON MEZQUITE TREND — Near-Surface Discovery 1.9km From Planned Pilot Plant; High-Grade Spikes To 16.0 g/t Au; Sonora, Mexico (CSE: TOC)
snippet: Tocvan Ventures Corp. (CSE: TOC) announced August 6, 2026 a new near-surface gold-silver discovery at its 100%-owned Gran Pilar Project in Sonora, Mexico, along the Mezquite trend — one of the project's most promising corridor targets. Hole JES-26-155 returned 215 metres of 0.6 g/t gold from 36.6 metres downhole, including three high-grade intervals up to 16.0 g/t gold and 57 g/t silver over 1.5 metres. The intercept splits into an upper zone of 86.9 metres at 0.6 g/t Au and a lower zone of 70.2 metres at 0.9 g/t Au with a continuous anomalous bridge between them. The new discovery is located approximately 1,900 metres east of the company's planned pilot production facility along existing road infrastructure — meaning any bulk-tonnage heap-leach scenario has direct access to processing without new road construction. Gran Pilar already has a planned pilot facility, which differentiates Tocvan from pure greenfield explorers: the path from discovery to initial production is partially built.

headline: ORETERRA LAUNCHES FIRST-EVER DRILL AT TREK SOUTH PORPHYRY — Adjacent To Galore Creek; Boulders Returned 2.86% Cu, 8.85 g/t Au; Golden Triangle BC (TSX-V: OTMC)
snippet: Oreterra Metals Corp. (TSX-V: OTMC) announced August 5, 2026 the commencement of a 5,000-metre first-ever drill programme at the Trek South porphyry copper-gold prospect in British Columbia's Golden Triangle — a target revealed only recently after a dramatic glacial ice pull-back exposed bedrock that has never been drilled. Trek South sits 10 kilometres from Teck-Newmont's Galore Creek copper-gold-silver deposits, one of the largest undeveloped porphyry systems in Canada, and composite boulder samples deposited by retreating glaciers at the prospect returned 2.86% copper, 8.85 g/t gold, and 46.5 g/t silver — grades consistent with a high-quality porphyry or high-sulphidation epithermal system. A second drill rig is joining the programme in approximately one week, roughly doubling capacity. At COMEX copper near $6.66/lb, a new porphyry copper-gold discovery adjacent to a 10+ million ounce gold equivalent resource base would represent one of the most significant new finds in the Golden Triangle in years.

headline: STANDARD URANIUM LANDS SE ASIAN STRATEGIC PARTNER — C$3M Private Placement Secures 19.7% Stake; Athabasca Basin Portfolio (TSX-V: STND)
snippet: Standard Uranium Ltd. (TSX-V: STND) announced August 7, 2026 that it has reached an agreement with an arm's length conglomerate from an undisclosed Southeast Asian nation to complete a C$3 million strategic investment at C$0.0765 per unit — 39,215,686 units each comprising one common share and a half-warrant. The investor will hold approximately 19.7% of the company on a non-diluted basis. Standard Uranium holds over 235,678 acres (95,375 hectares) of uranium exploration ground in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin — one of the world's highest-grade uranium districts. For retail investors, Southeast Asian strategic interest in an Athabasca Basin uranium explorer reflects the broader reality that nuclear capacity additions across Asia (South Korea, Japan restart, emerging market new builds) are creating corporate-level urgency to secure uranium supply chain relationships well upstream of production — at the exploration stage, before resources are defined.

headline: GOLD TERRA LAUNCHES ZONE 103N DRILL AT CON MINE — 595,000 Oz Inferred Extension Target; Q3 MRE Update Planned; Yellowknife NWT (TSX-V: YGT)
snippet: Gold Terra Resource Corp. (TSX-V: YGT) announced August 7, 2026 the start of drilling on Zone 103N — the northern extension of the Campbell Shear at the historical Con Mine in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories. The company's June 2026 Technical Report included an initial inferred resource of approximately 595,000 ounces at Zone 103N; the current drill programme aims to expand that resource ahead of a third-quarter mineral resource estimate update. Yellowknife's Con Mine produced approximately 5.1 million ounces of gold over its operating life, and Gold Terra holds the right to drill the Con Mine Option area along the Campbell Shear — arguably the most historically productive gold structure in Canada's NWT. With C$7.2 million of the company's recently raised C$9.2 million dedicated to drilling, Gold Terra is fully funded for an exploration campaign that could double its current resource base if Zone 103N extends north as the structural interpretation suggests.

headline: ENERGY FUELS BREAKS GROUND ON HEAVY RARE EARTH PLANT — 120 TPa Dysprosium, 20 TPa Terbium Target; $104M Utah Expansion; Online 2027 (NYSE: UUUU)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU, TSX: EFR) broke ground July 29, 2026 on a $104 million expansion of its White Mesa Mill in Utah to enable large-scale separation of heavy rare earth oxides — targeting 120 tonnes per annum of dysprosium, 20 tpa of terbium, 140 tpa of samarium, 20 tpa of europium, and 140 tpa of gadolinium, with terbium and dysprosium circuits online by end of 2027 and remaining circuits by 2028. Forbes coverage on August 4 frames this as a pivotal step in constructing a domestic US 'mine-to-magnet' rare earth supply chain: dysprosium and terbium are the heavy rare earths added to every high-performance neodymium-iron-boron magnet used in EV motors and wind turbine generators — and China currently controls over 90% of global supply of both. Capital is funded primarily through US government loans and grants. For mining investors, Energy Fuels' transition from a uranium producer into a vertically integrated rare earth processor is one of the most significant strategic pivots in North American critical minerals in years.
